summary: Chi-chiang Huang specializes in Buddhist studies, Sinology, and history and archaeology. He earned his PhD in 1986 from the University of Arizona, where he studied under Jing-shen Tao and Robert M. Gimello.

Chi-wah Chan is a scholar of Buddhist studies and Sinology who completed a PhD at the University of California, Los Angeles in 1993, studying under Robert Buswell and Benjamin A. Elman. Chan served as a Teaching Assistant at The Chinese University of Hong Kong.

Chia Theng Shen (1913–2007) was a Buddhist studies figure who founded the Institute for Advanced Studies of World Religions and held a post at the Buddhist Association of the United States from circa 1964 to 2007.
Chie Ikeya is a historian and archaeologist who completed a PhD at Cornell University in 2006, studying under David K. Wyatt.
Chien Y. Hsu works in Buddhist studies. Hsu studied under traditional teacher Zhenhua and doctoral supervisors Leslie S. Kawamura (until 2011) and James B. Apple (attested 2013).

Chien-hsing Ho works in philosophy, Buddhist studies, and Indology. Ho served as an Associate Professor of Religious Studies at Nanhua University (attested 2014) and held a post at Academia Sinica (attested 2018).

Chih-mien Adrian Tseng specializes in Buddhist studies, Sinology, and religious studies. He earned a PhD from McMaster University under James A. Benn, Nobuyoshi Yamabe, and Canshan Cheng, and became an Assistant Professor at Fo Guang University (attested 2016).

Chijo Akamatsu (1886–1960) studied religious studies at the University of Tokyo (~1907–1910) and Kyoto University (1910) under Bunzaburo Matsumoto. He held professorships at Keijo Imperial University (1927–1941), Ryukoku University (1943–1947), and Yamaguchi University (1950–1952).
Chijun Hamada is a Buddhist studies scholar who, in 1978, held posts as a research assistant (副手) at Taisho University and as a researcher at its Comprehensive Buddhist Studies Institute.

Chikafumi Watanabe specializes in Buddhist studies. He earned a master's at the University of British Columbia under Karin Preisendanz and Ashok Aklujkar, and completed a PhD at the University of Calgary under Leslie S. Kawamura in 1995.
Chikyo Yamamoto (1913–1999) was an Indology and Buddhist studies scholar who served as a professor at Koyasan University in 1970 and as a part-time lecturer there in 1980.
Chime Rinpoche (1941–2026) studied Buddhist studies and Tibetology under traditional teacher Khenpo Gangshar and held a post at the British Library around 1965.

Chin Kung (1927–2022) studied under Dongmei Fang, Lee Ping-nan, and the 7th Changkya Khutukhtu. He founded the Hwa Dzan Buddhist Library and the Corporate Body of the Buddha Educational Foundation, and served as president of Pure Land Learning College (~2001–2022).

Ching Keng is a scholar of Buddhist studies and philosophy who earned a PhD at Harvard University (2001–2009) under Robert M. Gimello and Parimal G. Patil, and became an Associate Professor at National Chengchi University around 2011.

Ching-mei Shyu specializes in Buddhist studies and Sinology. Shyu completed an MA at the University of Hawaiʻi under Jan Nattier and a PhD at Cornell University in 2008 under Daniel Boucher, Jane-Marie Law, and Hubert Durt.

Chintaharan Chakravarti (1900–1972) was an Indologist who served as professor at Presidency University and Presidency College, Chennai. He also held posts at Bethune College (attested 1941) and the Sanskrit Sahitya Parishat (attested 1960).
Chirapat Prapandvidya (born 1941) is an Indologist who taught Kazuhiro Yamamoto. He founded Silpakorn University, where he also served as director.

Chisan Koho (1879–1967) was a Buddhist studies figure educated at Komazawa University and Kyōdō Kōshūin under Soyen Shaku and others. He founded Tsurumi University in 1966 and served as abbot at Soji-ji (~1957–1967).
Chisei Tanaka is a scholar in Buddhist studies and Sinology who held positions at Mampuku-ji Bunkaden, including as director as attested in 2006.
Chisho Namai (born 1945) is a scholar in Buddhist studies and Indology who held posts at Koyasan University, serving as professor (attested 1996) and president (attested 2008).
